title: extract review run 결과 (v0)
description: 요구사항 추출 extract의 review run이 내는 결과 제안(requirements-extraction-flow.md 16.4, 16.7, 결정 12, AI 결정 112). 앱이 주장 칸에서 만든 맹검 질문(값·구성)에 답하고(비교는 앱이 한다), 행동 서술마다 반박을 시도한다. 반박에는 반대 앵커가 필요하다. 검토는 상태를 내리기만 한다. answers와 verdicts의 키는 앱이 패킷의 질문·서술 키로 채운다(결정 36). 공통 $defs는 survey·trace와 같아야 한다. 필드 설명은 영어로 쓴다(16.2, D98).

outcome.description: done: you answered every question and judged every statement. incomplete: deadline, limit or context ran out (checkpoint required).

outcome_reason.description: One or two sentences on why this outcome.

answers.description: One answer per question in the packet. The app fills the keys with the question keys.

verdicts.description: One verdict per statement in the packet. The app fills the keys with the statement keys.

unknowns.description: What code cannot settle and needs outside material, measurement or a person. Things you could still trace in code go to followups (trace) or units (survey).

checkpoint.description: Required when outcome is incomplete: where to resume. Otherwise null.

key.description: Local key, unique within this result (e.g. o1, q2). Other items point to it from refs.

refs.description: Keys of other items in this result.

configs.description: Configuration names this applies to, as named in the packet. Use the single name "all" only when a tool showed it is active in every confirmed configuration. Never merge behavior of different configurations into one item.

anchor.description: Where the evidence is. quote is a short verbatim copy of lines you opened in this run.

kind.description: code: source at the base commit. tool_output: output file of a tool you ran in scratch. doc_claim: a claim in a document or comment inside the repo. external_spec: material outside the repo (datasheet, standard).

path.description: Repo-relative path. For tool_output the output file in scratch; for external_spec the document id.

command.description: For tool_output the command you ran, otherwise null.

search.description: One search that supports an absence or a not_applicable.

tool.description: Tool used (Grep, Glob, a Bash command).

needs.description: What would settle it: external_doc (datasheet, spec), measurement (on real hardware), toolchain (a build or tool you could not run), other.

answer.description: Your own answer to one question, found in the code.

status.description: answered: you found it in the code. unknown: the code cannot settle it (say why in text).

text.description: The answer in one or two sentences.

values.description: For a value question: the value per configuration with its unit. Split when configurations differ. Empty for other questions.

configs.description: For a configuration question: every configuration where it is built and reached; empty if none. Empty for other questions.

value.description: Value with its unit as text (for example 20 tick); empty string if unknown.

verdict.description: Your attempt to refute one statement.

refuted: the code shows the statement is false (counter-evidence in anchors). overclaimed: it holds only under narrower conditions or in fewer configurations than stated (counter-evidence in anchors). needs_more: what you found neither supports nor refutes it. not_refuted: your attempts did not refute it.

attempts.description: What you checked to try to refute it.

anchors.description: Counter-evidence for refuted or overclaimed; otherwise the lines you checked.

note.description: Short note; empty string if none.
